name: Loni–Ghulewadi National Highway
significance: NH 160D is a branch of NH 160. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Loni to Ghulewadi, and it meets NH 160 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 160 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Sankeshwara to Kopargaon
